text: Sign up ke baad poocha jata hai ki aapka card kis kaam ke liye hai. Apni dukaan ya business ke liye, My own business or work par Continue dabaiye. Shubhora partner wala tareeka video ke aakhir mein dikhayenge.
Aapke products bhi card par aa gaye, price aur Order on WhatsApp button ke saath. Kuch badalna ho, to Edit card dabaiye.
Ye hai card editor. Chaar tab hain — Text and photos, Look, Buttons aur More. Yahan profile photo aur cover photo badal sakte hain.
Look tab mein barah look hain — Classic, Gradient, Dark, Royal aur kai aur.
Pasand ka look chuniye, aur upar Save dabaiye. Card turant update ho jata hai.
Create par My V-Card mein aapka link hai. Link copy kariye, ya seedhe WhatsApp par share kariye. Kuch badalna ho, to Change card dabaiye.
More options mein barah look, AI se aur text jodna, aur AI se poora card dobara banane ka option hai.
Yahan dikhta hai ki card kitna poora hua. Photo, timing, UPI aur reviews — har ek bas ek tap.
Apna naam ya mobile number badalna ho, to Me par jaiye, aur Edit name, mobile dabaiye.
Naya naam ya number likhkar Save dabaiye. Card, poster aur login — sab jagah ek saath badal jata hai.
Card pehle se bana ho, to My V-Card ke More options mein, Turn this into the Shubhora seller card bhi hai.
